Which_refresh_is_needed.inputs: @if(outputs('Is_unrouted'), 'This file matched no routing rule. Check the name (inventory names are case-sensitive), rename it and drop it again.', if(contains(toLower(triggerOutputs()?['body/{FilenameWithExtension}']), 'ytd sales detail'), 'Sales file: run the sales dataflow, then refresh the Sales model.', if(or(contains(triggerOutputs()?['body/{FilenameWithExtension}'], 'Distributor Month-End Inventory'), contains(triggerOutputs()?['body/{FilenameWithExtension}'], 'Distributor Backlog')), 'Inventory or backlog file: run the inventory dataflow, then refresh the Sales model.', if(or(contains(toLower(triggerOutputs()?['body/{FilenameWithExtension}']), 'quote log'), contains(toLower(triggerOutputs()?['body/{FilenameWithExtension}']), 'price list'), contains(toLower(triggerOutputs()?['body/{FilenameWithExtension}']), 'design registration'), contains(toLower(triggerOutputs()?['body/{FilenameWithExtension}']), 'contract')), 'Quotes, price list, registrations or contracts file: run the quotes ingestion pipeline, then refresh the Quotes and Sales models.', 'No mapping for this file name. Which_refresh_is_needed.description: Tells the on-call analyst what to run next. Refreshes are deliberately not triggered automatically because source file layouts change.
